title: Agnus Dei (Josquin)
desc: Josquin des Prez, Agnus Dei. 2 voices (Superior, Inferior), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Jos1311); encoded by Jesse Rodin. CC BY-NC 4.0. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
